subject.title: fix(openai): bound Codex image generation no-body response reads

question: Should OpenAI Codex image responses with no readable body and no strict usable `Content-Length` fail closed before any fallback read?
rationale: The code defect from the prior review is fixed, but rejecting unknown-size or malformed no-body responses is an intentional compatibility choice for a provider fallback path.

options.title: Accept Fail-Closed Policy
options.body: Land after maintainer review if availability hardening should reject unknown-size or malformed no-body Codex image responses before any full-buffer fallback read.

options.title: Preserve Compatibility Explicitly
options.body: Ask for a different bounded no-body strategy if custom no-stream endpoints without `Content-Length` must keep working.

options.title: Retarget No-Body Support
options.body: Pause or narrow the PR if no-readable-body Codex image responses are not a supported transport contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Fail-Closed Policy
recommendation.body: Land after maintainer review if availability hardening should reject unknown-size or malformed no-body Codex image responses before any full-buffer fallback read.
